verdict.rationale: Devin's MCP integration explicitly exposes 'scheduling' alongside session management (devin-docs-6), and CI/CD/SDLC integration lets Devin auto-respond to code review comments, CI failures, and static-analysis findings without a human in the loop (devin-docs-17, devin-docs-18, devin-docs-19), which matches trigger-driven autonomous maintenance. However, there's no dedicated first-party doc detailing how to configure a persistent 'always-on' scheduled agent (cron-like setup, monitoring dashboard) and community reports raise concerns about runaway/unsupervised sessions needing manual termination (devin-comm-2, devin-comm-5), suggesting real-world autonomy is imperfect. Missing for 10: dedicated scheduling/trigger configuration docs, independent evidence of long-running always-on agents working reliably without supervision.
